# Distribution Runbook — 30 min/day, $0

C6 (the agent) has **no social accounts, no inbox, no browser session**. It can
draft everything, but it cannot click Post or Send. This file is the complete
human operating procedure: 30 minutes a day, of which only a few minutes
strictly require YOU (marked 🔑 below). Everything else can be pre-drafted.

## The accounts you post from (all yours — set up once, ~20 min)

| # | Account | Used for | Setup |
|---|---------|----------|-------|
| 1 | YOUR X account | Daily posts from `social/queue.md` (Days 1–5, 8, 10, 13–14, 16, 18, 21, 23, 25, 27, 29) | Log in, add landing URL to bio: `YOUR-LANDING-URL` (see Links) |
| 2 | YOUR LinkedIn account | Posts on S1 slot days (Days 2, 4, 7, 9, 12, 13, 17, 19, 22, 26, 28, 30) | Log in, add same URL to featured/profile |
| 3 | YOUR Reddit / Discord / Slack identities | Reply-only days (Days 6, 11, 15, 20, 24) — genuine replies, no links unless rules allow | Join 2–3 relevant subs/servers NOW (e.g. freelance, small business, web dev). Read each one's self-promo rule before Day 6 |
| 4 | YOUR email inbox | Outbound templates + lead replies + kit delivery | Replace `hello@hydrocarbonforge.example` in `landing/*.html` with your real inbox before publishing |

Until payment rails exist, the "Buy" buttons open a pre-addressed email to you —
you reply manually with files + payment steps (bank transfer / cash / whatever
you and Gavin agree). See FAQ on `landing/index.html`.

## Links (fill these in before Day 1)

- `YOUR-LANDING-URL` — where you host `dist/landing/` (free: Cloudflare Pages /
  Netlify Drop / GitHub Pages — drag the `landing/` folder, done, ~10 min).
  Files: `index.html` (main page), `sample.html` (free lead magnet),
  `pricing-calculator.html` (free tool).
- Link the SAMPLE page (`sample.html`), not the buy page, in your X/LinkedIn
  bio and in the 1×/week soft CTA. Free converts; the sample sells the kit.
- After hosting, put the real URL in your bios + in this file (replace
  `YOUR-LANDING-URL`).

## Daily 30 minutes (Mon–Fri; weekends optional engage-only)

| Min | What | Detail |
|-----|------|--------|
| 0–3 🔑 | **Post today's queue item** | Open `social/queue.md`, find today's date row, copy the post, paste + hit Post on the listed platform. ~3 min, must be you (authenticated click). |
| 3–10 | **Outbound (2–3 sends)** | Pick 1 persona from `outbound/`, research 2–3 prospects (~3 min each — can be pre-drafted by C6 from a prospect list you paste), send from YOUR inbox/DMs. 🔑 Sending must be you. |
| 10–20 | **Engage (no posting)** | Reply to comments on your posts + answer 2–3 questions in your subs/servers helpfully, no links. Builds the permission to exist there. Can be you or drafted-then-approved. |
| 20–25 | **Follow-ups due?** | Check log: any proposal/outreach 4–5 days old with no reply → send the ONE follow-up template, close the loop. 🔑 Send must be you. |
| 25–30 | **Log + queue next** | Mark posted Y/N + replies in the tracking sheet at the bottom of `queue.md`. Tell C6 "draft tomorrow's post + 3 prospects for `[persona]`" so tomorrow starts warm. |

### 🔑 The human-only minutes, explicitly

Only THREE kinds of minutes strictly need the human (everything else C6 can
prepare as copy-paste text for you to approve):

1. **~1 min — the Post click** (your X/LinkedIn session; C6 has no login).
2. **~1 min — the Send clicks** (your inbox/DMs for the 2–3 outbound + any follow-up).
3. **~1 min — replying to a hot lead as yourself** (a real buyer conversation; never let the agent impersonate you).

Total unavoidable human time: **~3 min/day**. The other ~27 min is research,
engagement, and logging — valuable, but delegable/pre-draftable. If you're
slammed, do ONLY the 🔑 3 minutes (post + sends from pre-drafts) and skip the rest.

## Weekly (pick one day, +15 min)

1. Tally replies/saves per post. Top 3 → tell C6 to expand into longer posts.
2. Confirm only ONE soft-CTA post went out that week (Days 7/14/21/28).
3. Day-24 review: replace the Day 25–30 encore list with your actual top 6.
4. Check `landing/` inbox: every sample request answered within 1–2 days with
   the two files attached + one line pointing at the $49 kit.

## Rules that keep this at $0 and ban-free

- No scheduling tools with paid tiers, no automation, max 10 outbound/day.
- Reddit/Discord: replies only, no top-level promos, obey each community's rules.
- Zero fabricated metrics anywhere: slots are starting points, sample figures
  are labeled samples, no income claims on any page.
